label: The withholding holder is a willed two-way giver, by its HAS_INTELLECT_1 and one power
description: Argument B: #1897's withholding holder gives by will, not by chance, given its intellect and one power, with no Theta 5 principle. Not a transcription. Establishes no premise. Its omission models show what each premise carries: without the holder's intellect the chance rival (same frame, set-up and giving, non-rational power) satisfies every other premise; without one power, the intellectual chancer. It does not say that the holder is GOD_4 or unique, nor that the choice is contrastively explained. Connection plan: the holder's intellect premise needs the holder-root identification (#1897 note, gap 2); a consumer on the root route is the q.19 a.4 creation-by-will node a94c5dfc, which needs a bridge from exercising a rational power in giving to its Wills relation (not built).
